gloss.intro: Ngā kupu e whakamahia ana e ngā kaiwhakawhanake (me ngā rōpū AI), i te reo māmā.
gloss.none: Kāore he kupu e hāngai ana.
gloss.switch.help: Ka whiwhi ngā kupu ira i tētahi whakamārama māmā ina whakaarahia koe.
gloss.backlog.text: Ngā whakaaro me ngā mahi kāore anō kia whakamaherehia. Kāore he mea ki reira e mahia kia neke ki Hei mahi.
gloss.sprint.text: He wā poto o te mahi (te nuinga he wiki, e rua wiki rānei) me tētahi huinga kāri kua whakaaetia hei whakaoti.
gloss.standup.text: He tirotiro tere: i mahi ia mema rōpū i te aha, ka aha ā muri, he aha te mea e aukati ana i a ia.
gloss.bug.text: He mea kāore e mahi pērā i te tika.
gloss.test.text: Te whakamātau i tētahi mahi kua oti kia kite mēnā e mahi ana i te mea i tonoa, i mua i tō whakaae.
gloss.commit.text: He hopu kua tiakina o te waehere, me tētahi tuhipoka poto mō te mea i panoni. Ka taea tonu te hoki ki tētahi.
gloss.push.text: Te tuku i ngā hopu kua tiakina (commits) mai i tēnei rorohiko ki GitHub, kia tiakina, kia tiri ai.
gloss.branch.text: He rārangi mahi motuhake i te waehere, kia taea ai ngā panonitanga me te kore e pā ki te putanga matua.
gloss.merge.text: Te whakahoki i ngā panonitanga o tētahi peka ki te putanga matua.
gloss.repo.text: Te kōpaki waehere o te kaupapa me tōna hītori katoa o ngā commits, te nuinga e tiakina ana hoki ki GitHub.
gloss.refactor.text: Te whakapai i te waehere me te kore e panoni i tāna mahi: ngā kōpaki iti ake, ngā ingoa mārama ake, he iti ake te tuaruatanga.
gloss.deploy.text: Te whakarewa i tētahi putanga hou kia ora, hei tauira ki tētahi tūmau e whakamahia ai e te tangata.
gloss.kanban.text: He papa me ngā pou (Hei mahi, E mahi ana, Oti) e neke ai ngā kāri mai i te mauī ki te matau i te wā e mahia ana te mahi.
gloss.wip.text: Mahi kei te haere: te nui rawa o ngā kāri hei pupuri e tētahi pou, kia whakaoti te rōpū i ngā mea i mua i te tīmata i ētahi atu.
gloss.pr.text: Te tono kia tirohia, kia whakakotahitia ngā panonitanga o tētahi peka ki te putanga matua.
gloss.hook.text: He whakahau iti e rere ana mā tōna ake i tētahi wā kua tohua, hei tauira ina tīmata tētahi nohoanga AI, kia rongo ai te rōpū i ō kōrero.
gloss.token.text: Te wae e tatauria ai te whakamahinga AI: tata ki ētahi pūrākau o te tuhinga kua pānuitia, kua tuhia rānei. Ko te iti ake o ngā tohu, ko te nui ake o tō mahere e toe ana.
gloss.agent.text: He AI e mahi motuhake ana i tētahi mahi: ka pānui i te waehere, ka hanga panonitanga, ka whakahaere tirotiro, ka pūrongo mai.

tour.intro: He ruarua ngā tauranga huri noa i te papa. Hia nui tāu e hiahia ana?

tour.welcome.title: Nau mai ki AI-gile
tour.welcome.text: He papa e mahi ai ngā rōpū AI, ā, ko koe te kaiwhakatau, te kaiwhakamātau me te kaiwhakaae. Anei te huarahi ki te kite i te wāhi.
tour.welcome.short: He tāpuku tere o te papa.
tour.welcome.why: Te whakaaro: mā ngā rōpū ngā mahi tāwai, ā, ko ngā mea anake e hiahia ana ki te tangata ka kitea e koe.
tour.rail.title: Ō kaupapa
tour.rail.text: Te kāinga, tō pouaka mai, ngā kōrerorero ki ngā kaihautū, ā, kotahi te ahua mō ia kaupapa. Ko te taimana waiporoporo e kī ana he mea e tatari ana ki a koe ki reira. Toia ngā ahua hei whakarite i tō raupapa.
tour.rail.short: Ngā kaupapa i te rēera (i raro i te pūkoro); ko ngā taimana papura te tohu e tatari ana tētahi mea ki a koe.
tour.rail.why: Mā te tiro kotahi e mōhio ai koe ki te wāhi e hiahiatia ana koe, me te kore e whakatuwhera i tētahi mea.
tour.inbox.title: Tō pouaka mai
tour.inbox.text: Ngā mea katoa e tatari ana ki a koe, puta noa i ia kaupapa: ngā pātai, ngā mahi ko koe anake e ahei, me ngā mea hei whakamātau. Pātō i tētahi pūtau hei kite i taua momo anake.
tour.inbox.short: Ngā mea katoa e tatari ana ki a koe, ahakoa kei hea. Pātō i tētahi pūtau mō tētahi momo.
tour.inbox.why: Kaua koe e haere ki ia kaupapa hei mōhio he aha te mea e hiahia ana ki a koe.
tour.foryou.title: Māu
tour.foryou.text: I runga i tētahi papa, kei tēnei pou ngā mea e tatari ana ki a koe i taua kaupapa. Whakatuwheratia tētahi whakamātautau, whaia ōna hīkoi, ka Whakaae, ka Whakahoki rānei me tētahi take.
tour.foryou.short: Te puranga mōu o tēnei kaupapa: whakamātau, ka Whakaae, ka Whakahoki rānei.
tour.foryou.why: Kāore ngā rōpū e tohu i ā rātou ake mahi kua oti: ko koe te kaiwhakaae. Nā tēnā, kei ōu ringa te kounga.
tour.chat.title: Kōrero ki ngā kaihautū
tour.chat.text: Tukuna he karere ki te kaihautū o tētahi kaupapa me tētahi whakaaro, pātai rānei. Ka huri rātou i ngā whakaaro hei kāri me tētahi mahere poto, me ngā pātene Haere mōu.
tour.chat.short: Tukua he karere ki tētahi kaihautū; ka whakamahere rātou, ka pātō koe i Haere.
tour.chat.why: Kāore he mea e hangaia kia kī koe haere: ko koe tonu te rangatira o te mea ka puta.
tour.setup.title: Tautuhinga
tour.setup.text: Tōu ingoa, tō reo, tō kaupapa me te wāhi e noho ai te AI i tēnei rorohiko. He pūhera hoki hei whakamārama i ngā kupu kaiwhakawhanake, me te kuputaka.
tour.setup.short: Ōu tautuhinga, tō reo me te kuputaka kupu hangarau. I runga i te pūkoro kei raro i te rārangi i runga.
trial.help: He kape hou, kau o AI-gile i tōna matapihi ake (localhost:4400), me ngā kaupapa pohewa e toru hei kimi, me tētahi rōpū tākaro e whakautu ana ki a koe. Kia kite pai i tā tētahi hoa e kite ai i tana rere tuatahi. Kāore tō papa tūturu e pā; kāore he AI, kāore he utu.

gloss.title: 📖 Ngā kupu kua whakamāramatia
gloss.about: Ngā kupu ka tūtaki koe i roto i a AI-gile, i te reo māmā: te hanga, te panoni haumaru, te pupuri kia mahi tonu mō te hunga e whakamahi ana, me te mahi tahi hei rōpū me te AI.
gloss.about.noai: Ngā kupu ka tūtaki koe i roto i a AI-gile, i te reo māmā: te hanga, te panoni haumaru, te pupuri kia mahi tonu mō te hunga e whakamahi ana, me te mahi tahi hei rōpū.
gloss.g.team: 🤝 Te mahi hei rōpū (me te AI)
gloss.qa.text: Poto mō quality assurance (whakaū kounga): ngā arowhai aunoa ka rere i mua i te haere ora o tētahi mea. Ki te whero te QA, kua hapa tētahi mea, ā, kāore e taea te haere ora kia whakatikahia rā anō.
gloss.release.text: He paihere mahi kua oti, he ingoa tōna, ka haere ora tahi, me ngā kōrero poto mō ngā mea i panoni. Ka tuhia e 🚀 Tukunga ngā kōrero mai i ngā kāri kua oti.
gloss.rollback.text: Te hoki ki te putanga whakamutunga i pai te mahi, ina raru te putanga hou. I roto i a AI-gile ka hanga tēnei i tētahi rārangi-tirotiro o ngā hipanga huri whakamuri kua tuhia ki ia panonitanga.
gloss.live.text: Te putanga tūturu e whakamahia ana e te tangata, ehara i te kape hei whakamātau. E kīia ana hoki e ngā kaiwhakawhanake ko te production.
gloss.change.text: He panonitanga kua whakamaheretia ki tētahi mea e whakawhirinaki ana te tangata, kua tuhia i mua: he aha, he aha ai, te tūraru, āhea, me pēhea te huri whakamuri. Tīmatahia mā 🔀 Whakaara panonitanga.
gloss.risk.text: He mea ka hē pea, kua tohua he kaute mō te tūponotanga me te kino ka puta. Ka puritia e ⚠️ Ngā tūraru ki te rārangi kotahi, ko te kaute teitei rawa i mua, he rā tō ia mea kia tirohia anō.
gloss.chgwin.text: Ngā wā e āhei ai ngā panonitanga te haere ora, pēnei i tētahi ahiahi Tūrei mārie. I waho i te matapihi, kāore e taea te whakaoti i tētahi kāri panonitanga, ki te kore he ohotata.
gloss.gonogo.text: He pōti tere i mua tata i te haere ora o tētahi panonitanga: ka kī ia tangata me whakaae, Haere, Kaua e haere rānei. Ka haere whakamua anake ina whakaae rātou.
gloss.approval.text: Te tatari ki tētahi āe i mua i te tīmatanga o te mahi. Ka tatari tētahi kāri nā tētahi hoa i whakaara, he panonitanga rānei, i ✅ Ngā whakaaetanga kia whakaae, kia whakakāhore rānei koe.
gloss.quiettime.text: He wā, pēnei i te pāho, te whakaaturanga, te pō rānei, kāore he mea e haere ora. Ka mahi tonu ngā rōpū, ka whakamātau tonu, engari ka tatari te haere ora kia mutu rā anō. I ētahi atu wāhi ka kīia he change freeze.
gloss.service.text: He mea nāu i hanga e whakawhirinaki ana te tangata, pēnei i te paetukutuku, i te taupānga rānei, e tiakina ana kia mahi tonu. Tīkina “He ratonga tēnei kaupapa”, ka kī ai he aha tāna e tuku ana, ko wai e whakamahi ana, ko wai kei te on-call.
gloss.uptime.text: He arowhai aunoa, ia meneti torutoru, kei te whakautu tonu tō ratonga. Ki te hapa i ētahi wā e hia nei i te rārangi, ka whakatuwhera a AI-gile i tētahi kāri aitua mā ōna anō.
gloss.statuspage.text: He whārangi tūmatanui e whakaatu ana mēnā kei te mahi tētahi ratonga (kākāriki, karaka, whero rānei) me te pānui hou rawa, kia taea e te hunga whakamahi te tirotiro, kaua e pātai.
gloss.incident.text: He mea kua pakaru mō te hunga e whakamahi ana ināianei tonu, pēnei i te paetukutuku kua heke. Ka peke tētahi kāri 🔥 aitua i te rārangi: ko te whakahoki kia mahi anō te mea tuatahi.
gloss.major.text: He aitua nui: he tokomaha kua pāngia, he moni, he raraunga rānei kei te mōrearea. Ka whakanohoia e te pātene kotahi ngā rōpū katoa ki runga (kāhui), ka whakaohongia te tangata kei te on-call, ka tonoa he whakahou tūnga ia 30 meneti.
gloss.oncall.text: Ko koe te tangata ka whakautu ina pakaru tētahi mea, ahakoa i te pō. He mema rōpū on-call tō ia ratonga, ko ia te tuatahi ka whakaohongia mō ōna aitua.
gloss.replyby.text: Te roa ka taea e tētahi kāri te tatari mō te whakautu tuatahi, hei tauira kotahi hāora mō tētahi aitua. I muri i tērā ka whiwhi karaka whero, kia kaua tētahi mea e wareware puku. Ka kīia hoki he whāinga whakautu.
gloss.postmortem.word: Arotake i muri i te aitua
gloss.postmortem.text: He titiro poto whakamuri i muri i tētahi aitua: te mea i pā, te mea i āwhina me te mea me panoni, me te kore whakahē i tētahi. Kāore e taea te kati i tētahi aitua mēnā kāore he arotake.
gloss.problem.text: Te take huna kei muri i tētahi aitua, i ētahi aitua rānei. Ka whakarōpū tētahi kāri 🧩 raruraru i ngā aitua e hoki mai tonu ana, kia kitea ai te take, kia whakatikahia mō ake tonu.
gloss.rootcause.text: Te take tūturu i pakaru ai tētahi mea, ehara i te mea i kitea e koe e hē ana anake. Whakatikahia te pūtake tūturu, ā, ka mutu te hoki mai o te aitua.
gloss.workaround.text: He huarahi e mahi tonu ai ngā mea kia rite rā anō te whakatika tūturu, pēnei i te tīmata anō i tētahi mea ina mau. Ka tuhia ki te kāri raruraru kia kaua tētahi e whakaaro anō.
gloss.knownerror.also: ngā hapa e mōhiotia ana,known error
gloss.knownerror.text: He raruraru kua mārama te take, he aukati tōna, engari kāore anō kia whakatikahia. Ka whakarārangitia e 🧩 Ngā hapa e mōhiotia ana, kia whakamahi te katoa i te aukati, kaua e keri anō.
gloss.runbook.text: He tohutohu hipanga i te hipanga hei whakatika i tētahi momo raru e mōhiotia ana, kia ōrite te mahi, kia tere, i ia wā. I muri i tētahi aitua nui ka taea e te rōpū te tūtohu i tētahi mā tō OK.
gloss.backup.text: He kape kua tiakina o ō raraunga mai i mua, hei whakawhirinaki mēnā ka ngaro, ka pakaru rānei tētahi mea. Ka hanga a AI-gile i tētahi kape tiaki o ō papa ia rā.
gloss.restore.text: Te whakahoki mai i ngā raraunga i tētahi kape tiaki. Ka whai tikanga tūturu te kape tiaki ina mōhio koe ka taea te whakahoki mai, nō reira he pai te whakamātau i ētahi wā.
gloss.dod.also: Whakamārama o Rite,Definition of Done,Definition of Ready
gloss.dod.text: Te rārangi-tirotiro poto a te rōpū mō te tikanga o “oti”, pēnei i te whakamātautia me te whakamāramatia, i mua i te tukunga o tētahi kāri ki a koe. Ko tōna māhanga, te Whakamārama o Rite, e kī ana āhea e mārama ai te kāri kia tīmata.
gloss.testpile.text: Ngā kāri kua oti e tatari ana kia whakamātauria e koe, tētahi i muri i tētahi. Whakaaetia tētahi, whakahokia rānei me tētahi tuhipoka, ā, ka puta mai te mea e whai ake ana.
gloss.retro.text: He titiro whakamuri ki te āhua o te mahi a te rōpū, kia whakaae ki tētahi mea kotahi kia pai ake. I roto i a AI-gile ka tūtohu te retro i tētahi panonitanga ki ngā tikanga mahi a te rōpū, ā, ka kī koe Haere, Kāore anō rānei.
gloss.peerreview.text: He karu tuarua: ka tirotirohia e tētahi AI kē te mahi o ia kāri i mua i tōna taenga ki a koe, kia iti iho ngā hapa ka puta.
gloss.swarm.text: Ringa katoa ki te mahi: ka waiho e ia rōpū ētahi atu mahi hei āwhina i tētahi kaupapa ohotata kia oti rā anō. Ka tatari ētahi atu kaupapa i taua wā.
gloss.scrummaster.text: Te tangata e pupuri ana kia rere tonu te mahi: ka kite i ngā kāri kua mau, ka akiaki i ngā rōpū, ka whakamaumahara i a koe ki ngā mea e tatari ana. I roto i a AI-gile ko te Lead Scrum Master e mahi ana i tēnei puta noa i ngā kaupapa katoa.
gloss.scrummaster.text.noai: Te tangata e pupuri ana kia rere tonu te mahi: ka kite i ngā kāri kua mau, ka whakamaumahara i a koe ki ngā mea e tatari ana. Ki te kore he AI ka mahi mā ngā tono pūmau, pēnei i te tōtōpū i a Hei mahi.
